en.title: 30 Rock Stars Reunite on Tracy Morgan's Reggie Dinkins
en.summary: Fans of beloved sitcoms have a reason to celebrate as two iconic faces from 30 Rock are set to join Tracy Morgan in the upcoming season of The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins. This reunion promises a dose of nostalgic comedy for viewers.
en.body:
Get ready for a major dose of nostalgia, comedy fans! The upcoming second season of NBC's **The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins** is bringing together some familiar faces from the beloved sitcom **30 Rock**. Tracy Morgan, who stars as the titular Reggie, will be joined by not one, but two of his former co-stars from the iconic Tina Fey-created series.

Sources confirm that **Jane Krakowski**, who played Jenna Maroney on **30 Rock**, has officially signed on to guest-star in the new season. While details about her role are still under wraps, her presence alongside Morgan is sure to reignite the chemistry that made their **30 Rock** dynamic so memorable. Fans are already speculating about whether another **30 Rock** alum will be announced, further fueling the excitement for this reunion.

This isn't the only significant casting news brewing in the television landscape. Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, best known for his portrayal of Jaime Lannister in HBO's epic fantasy drama **Game of Thrones**, is set to star in a new supernatural horror series titled **The Black Tapes**. This eight-episode series will stream on MGM+ and is expected to delve into chilling mysteries and suspense, offering Coster-Waldau a chance to explore a darker, more genre-driven role.

## A Familiar Chemistry Returns

The decision to bring **30 Rock** cast members onto **The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins** is a strategic move that speaks volumes about the power of established comedic talent and fan loyalty. **30 Rock** ran for seven seasons and garnered critical acclaim, building a dedicated fanbase that still cherishes its unique brand of humor. For viewers who grew up with Morgan, Krakowski, and their **30 Rock** counterparts, this reunion offers a comforting echo of past enjoyment while introducing them to a new narrative.

Tracy Morgan's own journey in television has been marked by his breakout role on **30 Rock**, where his comedic timing and unique persona shone. Seeing him collaborate with former colleagues on his current series, **The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins**, suggests a creative environment that values shared history and comedic synergy. The series, confirmed to return to NBC, is clearly aiming to build on its established momentum by tapping into the goodwill generated by its star's past successes.

## What to Expect This Fall

Fans can mark their calendars for November 2, 2026, as the premiere date for the second season of **The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins**. This highly anticipated return promises more laughs, heartwarming moments, and now, a significant dose of **30 Rock** reunion magic. While the full guest cast and plot details for **The Black Tapes** are still emerging, Coster-Waldau's involvement in a horror series is a compelling draw for fans of the genre and the actor. Both shows are poised to deliver engaging content for diverse viewing audiences this fall.
